citation: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ — fa links to a perfect-tense narrative verb; there is no mood to license. This observable is equally consistent with fa being a plain listing ʿāṭifa (out-of-axis), so istinafiyya is never selected from this frame alone; the axis stays pending with every in-axis rival preserved. Candidate-only, not certified.

لَا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَقْعُدَ مَذْمُومًا مَّخْذُولًا — fa follows a prohibition and the linked verb تَقْعُدَ carries the visible subjunctive fatḥa; fā' al-sababiyya, licensed by an implied أَنْ, not by fa itself. Candidate-only, not certified.

REFUSAL CONTROL, not a claim about this word's true reading: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ is the same sababiyya frame as fa-occ-002 (17:22:7), but ayah 80:4 is currently absent from the repository's own address spine (a coverage accident, matching the established N1/N2/N4 refusal-control pattern in tools/test_nahw_governor_families.py). Evidence is never minted for an out-of-scope address; the real consumer's decision vocabulary has no 'refused' value, so the correct outcome is the ordinary pending/caller_occurrence_invalid refusal, not fabrication.
فَإِنْ أَمِنَ بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًا فَلْيُؤَدِّ ٱلَّذِى ٱؤْتُمِنَ أَمَانَتَهُۥ — fa links the apodosis; the jussive on يُؤَدِّ is governed by لْ (lām al-amr), never by fa. Candidate-only, not certified.

وَقَالَتْ أُولَىٰهُمْ لِأُخْرَىٰهُمْ فَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِن فَضْلٍ — fa resumes/links and is immediately followed by the DISTINCT negation particle مَا (its own function decided independently by negation_effect()/maa_context_frame() at this same address, never fused into a blended label). This observable does not itself exclude fa being a plain listing ʿāṭifa, so rabita is never selected from this frame alone; the axis stays pending with every in-axis rival preserved. Candidate-only, not certified.
